rules.structure: one block-final word per language; the block-review unit uses it as its final GeoWords, and Challenge reuses the review words of sections 1-5
rules.languages: EN and RU lists are independent
rules.approval: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {answer, definition}
rules.challengeExtra: extra words used only in Challenge GeoWords (Svetlana, 2026-10-23): CONTINENTALITY, EVAPOTRANSPIRATION, PRECIPITATION / МЕЖЛЕДНИКОВЬЕ, ГЛУБОКОВОДЬЕ. Words repeated across sections (RAINFOREST, SHIPWRECK, КОРАБЛЕКРУШЕНИЕ) are used once in Challenge
rules.workbookAnswers: answers from the printed GeoWords workbooks are used in the app deliberately (Svetlana, 2026-10-24)
rules.definitions: a definition never contains its answer word, nor a word of the same root (Svetlana, 2026-10-24); validate-dictionary.mjs checks the exact word and its forms

ru.definition: Человек, который ездит, ходит или плывёт по разным странам, чтобы увидеть новые места.

en.definition: How strongly the climate of a place is affected by being far from the ocean: the farther inland, the bigger the difference between summer and winter temperatures.
Water rising into the air from the land: it dries up from soil, lakes and rivers and is given off by plants through tiny holes in their leaves.
Water that falls from clouds to the ground as rain, snow, sleet or hail.

ru.definition: Тёплая эпоха, разделяющая два великих похолодания в истории Земли; сейчас на планете как раз такая эпоха.
Участок моря, озера или реки, где очень далеко до дна, вдали от мелей и берега.
